question.prompt: Toss 3 fair coins in succession. What is the probability that exactly 2 coins land heads up? (Write the result as a fraction in simplest form.)

solutions.explanation: The tree diagram has \(2\times2\times2=8\) equally likely outcomes. Exactly 2 heads occur in 3 outcomes: (heads, heads, tails), (heads, tails, heads), and (tails, heads, heads). The probability is 3/8.
solutions.title: Count equally likely outcomes
